caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical, tan-colored stoneware pottery crock with two small loop handles on either side and a thick, rounded rim. The surface of the crock features a dark blue decorative motif on the front, including the image of a deer or similar animal facing to the right, standing among stylized floral and leaf designs. Above the decoration, there is stamped text in blue that reads "FORT EDWARD POTTERY CO." along with the number "4." The interior of the crock is shaded darker brown, while the outer body retains a uniform, beige coloration. The artist’s signature is visible in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
